subject.title: Plugin UI: add scoped action bridge for sandboxed tabs

question: Should sandboxed plugin tabs gain this core mutation/navigation bridge, with context-window data derived authoritatively by the Gateway rather than supplied by the RPC caller?
rationale: This permanently expands the plugin SDK and crosses the read-only iframe boundary established by the recently merged tab-auth design; repository behavior alone cannot establish whether maintainers want that capability contract.

options.title: Approve after trusted derivation
options.body: Keep the scoped bridge, derive contextTokens from canonical session/model state, and require exact-head browser proof before merge.

options.title: Make it advisory only
options.body: Retain caller-supplied contextTokens only as explicitly untrusted metadata that plugins must not use for authorization, limits, or enforcement.

options.title: Defer mutation bridge
options.body: Keep sandboxed tabs read-only and revisit mutations when the plugin UI capability and trusted runtime-context APIs are designed together.

recommendation.title: Approve after trusted derivation
recommendation.body: Keep the scoped bridge, derive contextTokens from canonical session/model state, and require exact-head browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision extends the sandboxed-tab authentication and browser security boundary introduced by their recently merged work.
